title: Due-Date Changes on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
A due-date change can be made on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract only while the contract status is active.

**Counts.** The contract must show 0 days past due, installments satisfied of at least the tier's installments-satisfied figure for a change, and due-date changes used below the tier's lifetime allowance.

**Interval.** A due-date change may take effect no earlier than the minimum interval in calendar months after the last due-date change took effect. The interval is counted in calendar months from the last due-date change date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to that month's last day when the day does not exist; a contract that has never changed its due date has no interval to wait. A change taking effect on the day the interval ends is permitted.

**New due day.** The new due day must lie between the earliest and latest due days of the month, and the first installment on the new due day may fall no more than the tier's maximum shift in calendar days after the current next due date and never before it.

**Exception.** A change whose new due day equals the due day of another open Kestrel retail, pre-owned or balloon contract, or of an active Kestrel lease, of the same customer is a relationship alignment and does not have to wait for the interval; it still counts toward the lifetime maximum.

**Effect.** No fee is charged; simple interest continues to accrue daily, so a longer gap to the first installment on the new due day increases the interest portion of that installment. The change updates the due day, the next due date, the due-date changes used and the last due-date change date on the contract; the maturity date moves to the new due day in the final month.

### Interval boundaries (12-month interval, hypothetical dates)

| Last change took effect | Earliest date the next change may take effect |
|---|---|
| 31 August of one year | 31 August of the next year |
| 29 February of a leap year | 28 February of the next year (no 29th that month) |
| Never | no interval to wait |

A change on the day before the date in the right-hand column is too early, unless it is a relationship alignment.
